WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.858204 37.319739)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 440 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH source_poi AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-121.858204, 37.319739), 4326)::geography AS source_geom
),
dem_subset AS (
  SELECT 
    rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(source_poi.source_geom, 4326))
    )
),
elevation_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM 
    dem_subset
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Reclass(
      ST_Slope(elevation_raster.rast, '32BF'), 
      1, 
      '0-440:0,440-:1', 
      '32BF'
    ))).val AS is_lower,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Reclass(
      ST_Slope(elevation_raster.rast, '32BF'), 
      1, 
      '0-440:0,440-:1', 
      '32BF'
    ))).geom AS target_geom
  FROM 
    elevation_raster
),
filtered_areas AS (
  SELECT 
    target_geom
  FROM 
    elevation_values
  WHERE 
    is_lower = 0
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(ST_Distance(
      source_poi.source_geom, 
      ST_Transform(filtered_areas.target_geom, 4326)
    )) AS min_distance_meters
  FROM 
    source_poi, 
    filtered_areas
)
SELECT 
  min_distance_meters AS distance_to_lower_land_meters
FROM 
  nearest_distance;
